## SMBsync+ 2.55-plus.11

- Activity now shows the actual name of the last file checked during new sync runs, including runs that skip existing files.
- Sync messages put the file name above its path and keep the folder pair name as context.
- The simulation indicator says **Test mode** so it cannot be mistaken for a file name.
- Keeps the refreshed UI, corrected Sync and Run icons, background-only app lock, and **Report an issue** link from 2.55-plus.10.

The APK is built and signed by GitHub Actions with the same certificate as previous SMBsync+ releases. It can install over them without removing saved settings.

SMBsync+ is based on [SMBSync2 by Sentaroh](https://github.com/Sentaroh/SMBSync2). Source and license notices remain in this repository.
